regions.name: Mournwatch
regions.lore: Funeral lamps still burn in homes whose owners have been erased. Bellmaker Oren keeps one lit for his brother.
choices: Use the lamp to track the Regent

regions.name: The Cinder Cathedral
regions.lore: A choir of ash sings an unfinished burial rite. Cantor Sera fears the last verse will erase her own name.
choices: Sing the final verse with Sera
Bind the choir to defend the road

regions.name: Hollowmere
regions.lore: An undertaker ferries empty coffins across a red lake. Each coffin carries an unpaid promise.
choices: Pay the ferry toll for the forgotten

regions.name: Blackbell Citadel
regions.lore: Captain Rook guards a gate against soldiers who have forgotten which side they died for.
choices: Open the gate to the nameless

regions.name: Embergrave
regions.lore: Fire breaks through the burial fields. A smith has discovered the heat is fed by sealed soul vessels.
choices: Break the vessels and cool the field
Temper your ore in the soul furnace

regions.name: The Unnamed City
regions.lore: The city’s street signs are blank. Cartographer Eda draws the routes from memories she is slowly losing.

regions.name: Redwater Crypts
regions.lore: A flooded archive contains the first mortality tax. Its ink still stains the hands of anyone who reads it.
choices: Hold it as leverage over the council

regions.name: Widow's Reach
regions.lore: Nessa plants a tree for each returning soldier. The oldest tree whispers with her husband’s voice.
choices: Sever the binding for its aether

regions.name: The Broken Muster
regions.lore: A drummer repeats the signal to retreat, a century too late. Undead companies march toward the sound.
choices: Redirect the companies to the fortress

regions.name: Caves of the Ninth Bell
regions.lore: Miners uncovered a bell beneath the bedrock. Its ringing wakes sleepers in distant Lethiel.
choices: Muffle the bell with burial cloth
Study its link to the gardens

regions.name: The Ossuary Exchange
regions.lore: An illicit broker sells remembered birthdays. A child has come to buy back her mother’s age.

regions.name: Sanctuary of Last Breath
regions.lore: A necromancer keeps the mortally wounded alive by lending them his remaining years.
choices: Bind the sanctuary to your command

regions.name: The Ashen Crown
regions.lore: The Regent’s first champion offers a trial to anyone who will name the people buried beneath his throne.
choices: Dedicate the trial to the erased

regions.name: Ravenfall Pass
regions.lore: Refugees cannot cross until the watch beacons burn. The fuel is stored in an abandoned execution tower.
choices: Keep the beacon for your army

regions.name: Vesper Below
regions.lore: A community beneath the capital preserves names in songs. Their keeper asks whether the surface is safe.

regions.name: Moonfall Gardens
regions.lore: The flowers open only when someone remembers a childhood. Gardener Lune is running out of her own.
choices: Plant ordinary seeds beside the magic

regions.name: The Skyroot Temple
regions.lore: The temple hangs from roots that drink stolen years. A novice has found a way to lower it safely.
choices: Help the novice lower the temple
Keep the temple beyond mortal reach

regions.name: Glasswater
regions.lore: Fish swim through reflections of another sky. Fisher Tavi found her father’s face in the catch.
choices: Keep it to study the Covenant

regions.name: Starbough Haven
regions.lore: Children without dreams sleep under a luminous tree. Its keeper offers them dreams taken from Vesper.
choices: Help them make their own stories

regions.name: The Silver Cascade
regions.lore: The waterfall flows upward at moonrise. Engineer Nym suspects a buried engine is turning the valley’s seasons.

regions.name: Dreamless Refuge
regions.lore: Thalen’s apprentices shelter children beneath the roots. Their stores cannot survive another winter.

regions.name: Everspring Ruins
regions.lore: An abandoned elven city celebrates a festival with no living guests. Its lamps repeat the same spring forever.
choices: Keep a lamp burning for the lost

regions.name: Celestial Reach
regions.lore: Astronomer Vey tracks islands against stars that never move. The sky itself may be an old illusion.

regions.name: The Luminous Heart
regions.lore: A giant tree grows around a Vesper gravestone. Its oldest leaves remember the first treaty.
choices: Take a leaf for private study

regions.name: Prismspine Mountains
regions.lore: Crystal outcrops hum when an oath is broken. Pilgrims have left hundreds of apologies in the scree.
choices: Use the crystals to judge strangers

regions.name: Orchid Sea
regions.lore: A field of orchids follows travelers like a tide. Botanist Fenn believes each bloom seeks its original owner.
choices: Guide the flowers back to Vesper

regions.name: The Sunken Conservatory
regions.lore: Blind gardeners raise roots by listening to water. A merchant offers them sight in return for their garden.

regions.name: Grotto of Quiet Stars
regions.lore: Glowing moths spell names across a cave ceiling. The youngest explorer recognizes her own future epitaph.
choices: Let her choose a different path

regions.name: The Wild Court
regions.lore: Antlered spirits gather where hunters once paid tribute. Their speaker asks for an end to iron traps.

regions.name: The Dawn Observatory
regions.lore: A guardian tests whether visitors value beauty more than life. Its mirrors show the cost of every garden.
choices: Face the trial without the bargain

regions.name: Coppergate
regions.lore: Workers queue at gates built from their grandparents’ wages. Registrar Mira has found the original employment contracts.
choices: Return the contracts to the workers

regions.name: The Golden Harbor
regions.lore: Dockmaster Pell tracks ships that arrive without crews. Their cargo was paid for in years rather than coin.
choices: Release the cargo to bereaved families

regions.name: Ironwake
regions.lore: Ves’s apprentices power a forge with honest coal. The council undercuts them with stolen aether.

regions.name: The Merchant's Crown
regions.lore: A market judge weighs promises against silver. A widow’s promise is the heaviest thing on the scales.

regions.name: Aureate Palace
regions.lore: The palace guards polish an empty throne. The council hid the true succession in a locked public archive.

regions.name: Freeguild Market
regions.lore: Three guilds share a warehouse but disagree over its keys. A flood will reach the grain before their vote ends.

regions.name: The Clockwork Vault
regions.lore: A machine calculates interest on stolen childhoods. Its caretaker cannot find a number large enough for the debt.
choices: Transfer the accounts to your treasury

regions.name: The Last Mint
regions.lore: The mint’s final die bears no king. A young engraver asks whose face belongs on the new currency.
choices: Choose a symbol of the three peoples

regions.name: Library of Open Ledgers
regions.lore: Archivist Jun arranges forbidden ledgers by the names of victims. Soldiers have come for the index.

regions.name: The Hall of Petitions
regions.lore: Petitioners sleep beneath murals of prosperity. Clerk Daro has read every plea and remembers every refusal.
choices: Give the clerk authority to grant relief

regions.name: The Amber Granaries
regions.lore: Farmers grow food beside fields reserved for a royal parade. Their children have never seen the palace.
choices: Return the parade fields to farming
Tax the fields to fund defenses

regions.name: Bridge of Nine Charters
regions.lore: Nine guilds charge a separate toll on one bridge. A caravan carries medicine that will spoil by nightfall.

regions.name: Estate of Borrowed Summers
regions.lore: A noble’s orchard ripens all year while a neighboring village freezes. The roots reach the Golden Engine.
choices: Redistribute a share of its harvest

regions.name: The Concord Bastion
regions.lore: Soldiers from all three lands train together, but their banners tell three different accounts of the same battle.
choices: Keep the banners under one command

regions.name: Arena of the Uncrowned
regions.lore: A champion offers the council’s prize to anyone who can defeat him without accepting a title.
